correctness.rationale: Explicit direct enumeration of four maximal independent sets of F verifies \(\operatorname{VCdim}=1\) and \(\operatorname{Ldim}=2\). For G_m, maximal independent sets are the \(4^m\) product choices plus the universal singleton; concatenation shatters depth \(2m\) and cardinality limits online dimension to \(2m\). A support projection argument proves \(\operatorname{VCdim}=m\). Both logically different exhaustive finite algorithms classify every labeled graph on at most five vertices with no gaps through four and exactly two five-vertex gap types. The provided code was executed successfully.

value.rationale: The graph-order cutoff is a sharp natural minimal boundary, with complete isomorphism-level classification. Its unique P4-free five-vertex obstruction generates connected cographs with unbounded additive and a factor of two adaptive/static shattering separation. This pinpoints online-learning complexity not detectable from the small hereditary graph class or VC alone, and gives an exact dimension formula for every graph in the infinite family.
